purpose: One clean and one broken example per model check, and for most of them the broken one with the check's own suggestion applied. `jevlint self-test` runs all three: the span between clean and broken says whether the check measures anything, and the fixed one says whether its advice works. A check whose advice narrows a problem it cannot remove says so with `advice_clears: false` instead of shipping a fixed example that clears it some other way.
